# Recent lists completed work newest-first and honors its limit.
exec weft$exe init
exec weft$exe recent --json
json
stdout '"tasks": '
! stdout '"number":'

exec weft$exe add 'Earlier completion' --state todo
exec weft$exe done 001
exec weft$exe add 'Later completion' --state todo
exec weft$exe done 002

exec weft$exe recent --json
json
stdout '(?s)"number": "002".*"number": "001"'
exec weft$exe recent --limit=1 --json
json
stdout '"number": "002"'
! stdout '"number": "001"'
exec weft$exe recent
stdout '002'
stdout 'Later completion'

! exec weft$exe recent extra
stderr 'recent takes no positional arguments'
! exec weft$exe recent --recent
stderr 'weft recent: --recent is not supported'
